description:
Make exact-size passport and ID photos on a pharmacy print sheet — crop, tile, and export offline on your iPhone.

Passport Photo Print helps you prepare official photo sheets without uploading anything. Pick a country size, crop to the frame, pack multiple copies on 4×6 (or your paper size), and share a print-ready file.

FEATURES
• Exact crop frames for passport, visa, and ID sizes
• Tile multiple photos on a single print sheet
• Cut guides for clean trimming
• Export PNG or JPG for your photo lab
• Bookmarked sheets stay on this device
• Optional on-device background cleanup (where available)
• Works offline — photos never leave your phone

PRINT TIP
When you print, choose Actual Size / Uncropped so the sheet matches the sizes shown in the app.

PRO
A one-time Lifetime purchase removes ads permanently on your Apple ID.

IMPORTANT
This app is not affiliated with any government or passport office. Always check current official photo rules for your document before you submit.

Built by CODSE. Support: support@codse.com
promotionalText: Crop to size. Tile a sheet. Print at home — offline.
